description_en: Create a snapshot for a disk of a cloud computer to back up or restore the data on the disk
description_zh: 为云电脑的磁盘创建一份快照，用于备份和恢复磁盘上的数据
kebab_example: aliyun ecd create-snapshot --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --desktop-id ecd-gx2x1dhsmucyy0000 --snapshot-name testSnapshotName --source-disk-type system --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateSnapshot

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the cloud computer
parameters.name: desktop_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the snapshot. The name must be 2 to 127 characters in length. The name must start with a letter. The name can contain letters, digits, underscores (_), and hyphens (-). The name cannot start with `auto` because snapshots whose names start with auto are recognized as automatic snapshots
parameters.help_zh: 快照的显示名称。长度为2\~127个英文或中文字符。必须以大小写字母或中文开头。可以包含数字、下划线（_）或者短划线（-）。为防止和自动快照的名称冲突，不能以`auto`开头
parameters.name: snapshot_name

parameters.help_en: The description of the snapshot. The description can be up to 128 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 快照描述。长度不能超过128个英文或中文字符
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
The type of the disk for which you want to create a snapshot.

Valid values:
